parameters.name: connection_id
parameters.description: Required. The Airbyte ConnectionId UUID between a source and destination.

parameters.name: airbyte_conn_id
parameters.description: Optional. The name of the Airflow connection to get connection information for Airbyte. Defaults to "airbyte_default".

parameters.name: asynchronous
parameters.description: Optional. Flag to get job_id after submitting the job to the Airbyte API. This is useful for submitting long running jobs and waiting on them asynchronously using the AirbyteJobSensor. Defaults to False.

parameters.name: deferrable
parameters.description: Run operator in the deferrable mode.

parameters.name: api_version
parameters.description: Optional. Airbyte API version. Defaults to "v1".

parameters.name: wait_seconds
parameters.description: Optional. Number of seconds between checks. Only used when ``asynchronous`` is False. Defaults to 3 seconds.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Optional. The amount of time, in seconds, to wait for the request to complete. Only used when ``asynchronous`` is False. Defaults to 3600 seconds (or 1 hour).

parameters.name: airbyte_conn_id
parameters.description: Optional. The name of the Airflow connection to get connection information for Airbyte. Defaults to "airbyte_default".

parameters.name: api_version
parameters.description: Optional. Airbyte API version. Defaults to "v1".

parameters.name: airbyte_job_id
parameters.description: Required. Id of the Airbyte job.

parameters.name: deferrable
parameters.description: Optional. Runs the sensor in deferrable mode. Defaults to the config value "default_deferrable" or False, if not defined.

parameters.name: airbyte_conn_id
parameters.description: Optional. The name of the Airflow connection to get connection information for Airbyte. Defaults to "airbyte_default".

parameters.name: api_version
parameters.description: Optional. Airbyte API version. Defaults to "v1".

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: The ID of an Airbyte Sync job.

parameters.name: conn_id
parameters.description: The connection identifier for connecting to Airbyte.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Time in seconds to wait for a job run to reach a terminal status. Defaults to 7 days.

parameters.name: poll_interval
parameters.description: polling period in seconds to check for the status.
